page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance is equipped with two NVIDIA P4 graphics processing units, delivering a combined total of 16 GB of VRAM to support accelerated computing tasks.

This server configuration does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps. A key hardware tradeoff is the reliance on the older NVIDIA P4 GPU architecture and the complete absence of local NVMe or SSD storage, which requires careful architectural planning for data-intensive applications.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn5i-c16g1.8xlarge offers a dense multi-GPU configuration suitable for entry-level deep learning inference, video transcoding, and parallel computing tasks that do not require the latest generation of GPU hardware. It is designed for workloads such as media processing, machine learning inference, and general-purpose GPU-accelerated applications.
